name: Tile-based Depth Sorting
definition: A method to mitigate 'popping' artifacts caused by per-ray depth sorting inconsistencies when viewpoints rotate, by replacing per-ray sorting with tile-based sorting.
summary: Tile-based Depth Sorting mitigates popping artifacts in 3D Gaussian Splatting by replacing per-ray depth sorting with tile-based sorting to ensure consistent depth ordering within local regions.
